correctness.rationale: The rank-k vertices are all injections assigning n,...,n-k+1 to a k-subset of coordinates. Rearrangement bounds cross-rank Euclidean distance below by n-k, while different same-rank supports are separated by at least sqrt(2)(n-k+1); only swaps of consecutive labels create sqrt(2) connections within supports. At n<=m unique distance-one deletion of label 1 links the top two ranks. The explicit component merger filtration proves H_0 multiplicities and hence every complete Euclidean MST edge spectrum. Checked n=1, m=1, n=m and n=m+1 boundary branches, and independent full-pair Kruskal for 24 profiles (m=1..4,n=1..6) matched exact histograms; finite check is not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Known partial permutohedron theorems identify the vertex/face/skeleton adjacency and its Euclidean edge-length spectrum for n>=m. MST and VR H_0 depend on all vertex pairs, including nonedges, and the proposed all-pairs separation theorem plus n<m transition is not a corollary of skeleton adjacency or its edge-weight totals. Cardinal–Steiner count skeleton steps rather than Euclidean minimum-spanning lengths.
